sensitivity.label: Mouse sensitivity
sensitivity.help: How far the view turns for each bit of mouse movement (thousandths of a radian per pixel). The view follows the mouse exactly: no smoothing, no acceleration. Also scales the gamepad's right stick.

invertY.label: Invert up/down
invertY.help: On: pushing the mouse forward looks down (flight-stick style). Some players need this.

pitchLimit.label: Look up/down limit (degrees)
pitchLimit.help: How far you can look up or down. Under 90 so the view can never flip over.

fov.label: Field of view (degrees)
fov.help: How wide the view is. Wider feels faster and shows more, but bends the edges. 65-80 suits most people.

sprintFovKick.label: Sprint view widening
sprintFovKick.help: Extra degrees of view while sprinting: the cheap trick that makes running feel fast. 0 = off (kinder for motion sickness).

walkSpeed.label: Walk speed
walkSpeed.help: Metres per second. The same forwards, sideways and diagonally.

sprintSpeed.label: Sprint speed
sprintSpeed.help: Metres per second while holding Shift and moving forward.

groundAccel.label: Grip when starting
groundAccel.help: How fast you reach full speed. Low = sluggish, like walking on ice.

stopAccel.label: Grip when stopping
stopAccel.help: How fast you stop when you let go. High = you stop where you meant to.

airControl.label: Air control
airControl.help: Share of your grip you keep in the air, so you can steer a jump a little.

jumpSpeed.label: Jump speed
jumpSpeed.help: Upward speed at take-off. Height = speed squared / (2 x gravity): about 0.95 m here, enough for the low walls (0.8 m).

gravity.label: Gravity
gravity.help: Pull while rising, metres per second squared.

fallGravity.label: Fall gravity x
fallGravity.help: Extra pull on the way down. Above 1 makes jumps land crisply instead of floating.

coyoteTime.label: Coyote time (s)
coyoteTime.help: You can still jump this long after walking off an edge.

jumpBuffer.label: Jump buffer (s)
jumpBuffer.help: A jump pressed this long before landing still happens.

stepHeight.label: Step-up height (m)
stepHeight.help: Ledges up to this high are walked up without jumping (stairs, kerbs, the ruin floor).

bobHeight.label: Head bob (up/down, m)
bobHeight.help: How much the view dips on each footstep. 0 = a perfectly steady view (best for anyone who gets motion sick).

bobSway.label: Head bob (side to side, m)
bobSway.help: How much the view shifts from foot to foot. 0 = off.

strideLength.label: Stride length (m)
strideLength.help: Metres between footsteps. Bob and footstep sounds follow distance walked, so they speed up when you sprint.

landDip.label: Landing dip (m)
landDip.help: How far the view sinks when you land from a jump. 0 = off.

handSway.label: Hand sway
handSway.help: How much the hand lags behind when you turn. 0 = a rigid hand.

handBob.label: Hand bob
handBob.help: How much the hand and lantern swing as you walk. 0 = still.

range.label: Reach (m)
range.help: How close you must be to use something.

coneDegrees.label: Use cone (degrees)
coneDegrees.help: How far from the centre of the view a thing can be and still count as looked at. Small = fiddly, large = forgiving.

holdTime.label: Hold to use (s)
holdTime.help: How long Use must be held. The ring fills as you hold and drains slowly if you let go. 0 = one press does it. The hold is what makes a shade nearby a problem: stun it first.

speed.label: Spark speed
speed.help: Metres per second. Fast = it lands where you looked.

range.label: Spark range (m)
range.help: How far a spark flies, and how far aim assist reaches.

assistDegrees.label: Aim assist (degrees)
assistDegrees.help: A shade this close to the crosshair gets the spark thrown straight at it. 0 = no help.

hitRadius.label: Spark hit size (m)
hitRadius.help: How near a shade the spark must pass to hit. Bigger than it looks, on purpose.

maxCount.label: Shades
maxCount.help: One shade haunts each dark lantern (except the first you meet), up to this many. A shade caught in a lantern's light as it is lit is gone for good; the rest keep following you. Takes effect on the next run.

wakeRange.label: Notices you from (m)
wakeRange.help: A haunting shade leaves its lantern and comes for you when you get this close.

restless.label: More restless per lantern (m)
restless.help: Each lit lantern adds this to how far away the remaining shades notice you. This is the pressure that grows: early shades wait for you, late ones come and find you.

speed.label: Drift speed
speed.help: Metres per second. Deep dusk adds about a third, each lit lantern a little more, but never more than 85% of walk speed: you must always be able to walk away.

speedPerLantern.label: Speed-up per lantern
speedPerLantern.help: Each lit lantern makes the shades this much faster: the pressure that grows.

lungeRange.label: Lunge from (m)
lungeRange.help: A shade this close stops and winds up.

windup.label: Warning before a lunge (s)
windup.help: The hiss and the swell. Long enough to step aside; under 0.4 feels unfair.

lungeSpeed.label: Lunge speed
lungeSpeed.help: Metres per second of the short rush after the hiss. Speed x length = how far it reaches (about 4 m): a sidestep during the hiss must be enough to dodge it.

lungeTime.label: Lunge length (s)
lungeTime.help: How long the rush lasts. Longer = it reaches further and is harder to dodge.

recover.label: Rest after a lunge (s)
recover.help: Your opening: walk away or throw a spark.

touchRadius.label: Touch distance (m)
touchRadius.help: How close a shade must come to hurt. Smaller than the shade looks: near misses go to the player.

stunTime.label: Stun length (s)
stunTime.help: How long a spark takes a shade out.

hearRange.label: Heard from (m)
hearRange.help: The whisper starts here and grows as the shade nears; the heartbeat starts at about half this.

hintRange.label: Edge hint from (m)
hintRange.help: A shade behind you this close shows as a glow on the edge of the screen.

safeRadius.label: Safe circle (m)
safeRadius.help: The radius of light round a lit lantern. Shades cannot enter it, and any shade inside it at the moment of lighting is banished.

brightness.label: Lantern brightness
brightness.help: How strongly a lit lantern lights the world around it.

duskSeconds.label: Dusk takes (s)
duskSeconds.help: How long until the evening is at its darkest. The run's clock: shades get quicker and more numerous as it darkens.

duskDepth.label: How dark it gets
duskDepth.help: 0 = the light never changes, 1 = nearly night. Your own lantern and the lit ones matter more as it darkens.

handLight.label: Hand lantern brightness
handLight.help: How strongly the lantern you carry lights what is near you (at full dusk).

lightStopMs.label: Lighting freeze (ms)
lightStopMs.help: A tiny freeze when a lantern lights: it makes the moment land. 0 = off.

hitStopMs.label: Hurt freeze (ms)
hitStopMs.help: A short freeze when a shade touches you, so you feel the hit and see what happened. 0 = off.

hitShake.label: Hurt shake (m)
hitShake.help: First-person shake is strong medicine: keep it small. 0 = off.

invincible.label: Invincible
invincible.help: Shades cannot take warmth (for testing and for a pure walking game).
